$comment: GENERATED by `oats-meetings-rs config generate` from crates/core/src/config/keys.rs; do not edit

single_instance.description: Refuse to start a second engine on the same control socket.

backend.description: Capture backend: auto picks per OS (Linux: pulse, else pipewire; Windows: cpal/WASAPI; macOS: screencapturekit, whose system-audio source is audio.system_backend).

devices_timeout.description: How long devices-list (and the device check of a reload) waits for the audio backend to list its devices before failing with devices_timeout; the GUI shows devices unavailable.

devices_ttl.description: How long a device listing is reused before the audio backend is asked again.

echo_block.description: Samples per echo-canceller block (rounded up to a power of two): smaller adapts faster, larger costs less.

echo_cancel.description: Cancel speaker echo in the mic using system audio as the reference, and drop local-speaker utterances that repeat near-simultaneous remote speech, so remote speech is not transcribed twice.

echo_delay.description: Mic delay inside the echo canceller, so system audio that is captured a little after its echo reached the mic is still cancelled; both channels are shifted by it.

echo_divergence.description: Percent: the echo canceller's output filter takes the adapting filter when its residual is this many times smaller, and resets it when it is this many times larger (double talk).

echo_dominance.description: Percent: during audio.echo_warmup, mic sound whose echo-cancelled residual is below this share of its energy is mostly speaker echo and is muted; local speech, which system audio cannot predict, stays.

echo_step.description: Echo-canceller adaptation step in per-mille (500 = 0.5): larger converges faster, smaller is steadier.

echo_tail.description: Longest speaker-to-mic echo the echo canceller models (audio.echo_cancel).

echo_warmup.description: System-audio sound the echo canceller hears before it counts as converged: until then it adapts with audio.echo_warmup_step and mutes the mic where echo dominates (audio.echo_dominance), so the first remote sentence is not transcribed as you. 0 turns the warmup off.

echo_warmup_step.description: Echo-canceller adaptation step in per-mille during audio.echo_warmup (never below audio.echo_step).

layout.description: WAV layout: split is two channels (left system audio, right mic); mix is one summed channel.

device.description: Microphone device id (see `ctl devices list`); empty means the default mic.

open_timeout.description: How long a capture backend waits for audio to start flowing before giving up.

poll_interval.description: Pause of the recorder writer and of capture readiness polling.

device.description: System-audio loopback device id (see `ctl devices list`); empty means the default loopback.

enabled.description: Record system audio (what the machine plays).

system_backend.description: macOS system-audio source: auto is a Core Audio process tap on macOS 14.2+ (System Audio Recording permission), falling back to ScreenCaptureKit (Screen Recording) on older macOS or a failed tap; tap or screencapturekit force one. Ignored on other OSes.

transcribe.description: Transcribe while recording (stt.* settings): on fails record-start if the ASR is unavailable, auto records audio only then, off never transcribes.

hot_reload.description: Watch the user config file and reload on change.

poll_interval.description: How often the user config file is checked for changes while config.hot_reload is on.

accept_backoff.description: Wait after an accept error before trying again.

accept_poll.description: Idle wait of the control-socket accept loop between checks.

client_timeout.description: Default wait of oats-ctl for events or for an engine that is still starting (its --timeout-ms flag overrides).

drain_chunk.description: Bytes read per step while discarding the rest of an oversize request line.

drain_max.description: Most bytes discarded from one oversize request line before the connection is closed.

event_queue.description: Events queued per subscriber before a slow one is dropped.

max_line.description: Largest control-socket request line, in bytes; longer lines are refused.

socket.description: Control socket path; empty means the per-user runtime dir.

all_day.description: Whether all-day events appear in ics-events.

allow_file.description: Allow file:// feeds (local, not gated by network.allow).

cache_dir.description: Directory for cached feeds; empty means ics/ beside the sessions dir.

cancelled.description: Whether STATUS:CANCELLED events appear in ics-events.

default_refresh.description: Time between automatic refreshes of a feed with no refresh_secs of its own; 0s means manual only.

default_tz.description: IANA zone for floating times and for the midnight bounds of all-day events.

enabled.description: Master switch for refreshing feeds (manual and scheduled). Cached events stay readable.

feeds.description: JSON array of feeds: {name, url, enabled, refresh_secs, header}. Edit with ics-add / ics-remove.

max_bytes.description: Largest feed body accepted, in bytes.

max_occurrences.description: Most occurrences expanded per recurring event per query.

on_bad_event.description: A malformed event fails the whole feed (error) or is dropped and counted (skip).

poll_interval.description: How often the feed scheduler checks which feeds are due.

stale_on_error.description: When a refresh fails, keep serving the last good cached copy.

timeout.description: Whole-request timeout for a feed fetch.

unknown_tz.description: An unknown TZID fails the event (error) or falls back to ics.default_tz.

webcal_scheme.description: Scheme webcal:// URLs are fetched with.

window_days.description: Default length of the ics-events window in days when no end is given.

base_url.description: Embedding endpoint base URL for kb.embedder ollama / openai-compatible.

dir.description: Knowledge-base folder of .md/.txt files; empty means <data dir>/kb.

embedder.description: KB embedder: local deterministic hashing, or a model endpoint (gated by network.allow unless loopback).

hash_dims.description: Vector length of the local hash embedder. An index records it: changing it makes kb-search refuse the old index until kb-reindex rebuilds it.

max_chunk.description: Largest KB chunk, in characters; longer paragraphs are cut.

min_chunk.description: Smallest KB chunk kept, in characters; shorter fragments are dropped. Must not exceed kb.max_chunk.

model.description: Embedding model name for the ollama / openai-compatible embedders.

timeout.description: Whole-request timeout for a KB embedding call.

holder.description: Licence holder metadata (placeholder; no licence chosen).

api_key_ref.description: Reference (secret:<namespace>/<name>) to the LLM API key in the secrets backend. The key itself is never in config; store it with secret-set.

base_url.description: LLM endpoint base URL; empty means the backend default (required for openai-compatible).

model.description: Model name sent to the LLM backend.

timeout.description: Whole-request timeout for a notes-generation LLM call.

allow.description: Allow outward network calls (cloud STT / LLM). Off means such backends are denied.

error_snippet.description: Characters of a failing HTTP reply kept in the error message (LLM, embedding and cloud STT calls).

confirm_regenerate.description: Regenerating over existing notes in the Notes view needs a second click.

default_template.description: Template the Notes view picks for regenerating; empty means the first one listed.

enforce_headings.description: Reject generated notes that lack a '## ' heading the template's prompt demands.

hide_from_capture.description: Hide the app window from screen capture.

hide_method.description: How hiding is done; set per OS by the os axis.

backend.description: Where secret:<key> references are resolved: environment variables, the OS keychain, or env first then keychain.

env_prefix.description: Prefix of the environment variable holding a secret: secret:ics/work reads OATS_SECRET_ICS_WORK.

keyring_service.description: Service name secrets are filed under in the OS keychain.

confirm_delete.description: Require confirm=true to delete a session.

delete_mode.description: Deleting a session moves it to the OS trash (trash) or removes it for good (remove). Provisional default.

max_id_len.description: Longest session id (it becomes a directory name).

root.description: Session store directory (OpenOats layout); empty means the per-user data dir.

search_snippet_chars.description: Characters of context kept either side of a transcript-search match in its snippet (the Sessions search shows it under the row).

backend.description: Speech-to-text backend: on-device or a cloud adapter.

adapter.description: Cloud STT adapter; must not be none when stt.backend is cloud.

key.description: Secret reference for the cloud STT API key (never the key itself); see the secrets module.

max_response.description: Largest cloud transcription reply accepted, in bytes.

model.description: Model name sent to the cloud STT service.

timeout.description: Whole-request timeout for one cloud transcription.

url.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible transcription API.

enabled.description: Split the system-audio (them) channel by voice: its utterances are labelled stt.speaker_them, then remote_2, remote_3 ... per distinct remote speaker. The microphone channel is always stt.speaker_you. Off labels all remote speech stt.speaker_them.

max_speakers.description: Most remote speakers the diarizer tells apart; past this an utterance joins the most similar speaker heard.

min_new.description: A remote utterance shorter than this never starts a new speaker (too little audio for a reliable voice print); it joins the most similar one.

threshold.description: Percent voice-print (cosine) similarity at which a remote utterance belongs to a speaker already heard; below it the utterance starts a new remote speaker. Higher splits voices more readily.

echo_overlap.description: Percent of a local-speaker utterance's words that must appear in near-simultaneous remote speech for it to be dropped as echo (stt.echo_window).

echo_similarity.description: Percent: a local-speaker word counts as appearing in remote speech (stt.echo_overlap) when its letter edit-distance similarity to a remote word is at least this, so a misheard echo ('Oaks meeting' for 'Oats Meetings') is still dropped. 100 asks for the exact word.

echo_window.description: With audio.echo_cancel, a local-speaker utterance within this time (plus audio.echo_delay) of remote speech that says the same, or nearly the same (stt.echo_similarity), words is dropped as speaker echo.

feed.description: Window used to feed a recorded file to the live pass as if it were arriving.

enabled.description: Re-transcribe the whole recording when it stops and write transcript.final.jsonl.

final_piece.description: Longest stretch sent in one request in the final pass (cloud uploads are size-limited).

language.description: Spoken language code passed to the recogniser.

chunk.description: Length of audio per live transcription window.

enabled.description: Transcribe while recording and write transcript.live.jsonl.

auto_download.description: When the selected local model is missing at app launch (or when a recording starts), download it in the background (about 660 MB for the default Parakeet v2); recordings saved as audio only meanwhile are transcribed when it finishes. Picking a model in the Models tab also downloads it when this and network.allow are both on. Off means transcription stays unavailable until you run `ctl stt model fetch` or press Download. A download you ask for with stt-model-fetch is not gated by this or by network.allow.

model.description: Local ASR model: an id from the model catalog (stt-model-list shows each with its size, WER and speed). The catalog entry decides the runtime: whisper.cpp for the Whisper models, sherpa-onnx for Parakeet and Moonshine, CoreML for parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2-coreml (the default: Parakeet v2 on the Apple Neural Engine, as FluidAudio runs it). Where a build has no CoreML (Linux, Windows), or CoreML cannot load the model, parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2-coreml runs as parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2 through sherpa-onnx on the CPU; stt-status reports the runtime and compute units in use.

model_path.description: Explicit path to the local model; empty means where the model catalog puts stt.local.model under models_dir (a ggml-*.bin file for whisper.cpp models, a directory of files for sherpa-onnx models). Nothing is downloaded for an explicit path.

model_url.description: Mirror for model downloads: empty fetches each file from the URL in the model catalog; set, a file comes from <url>/<file> (whisper.cpp) or <url>/<model dir>/<file> (sherpa-onnx). Every file is checked against the catalog's SHA-256, so a mirror must serve the same bytes.

models_dir.description: Directory holding local model files; empty means models/ beside the sessions dir.

piece.description: Longest stretch a sherpa-onnx model (Parakeet, Moonshine) decodes at once; longer audio is cut at the quietest point near this length, which bounds memory on long recordings. Each piece is split into sentences by the model's token times. A CoreML model decodes at most its encoder window (15 s for Parakeet v2) at once, cut the same way.

provider.description: Where sherpa-onnx models (Parakeet, Moonshine) run: auto uses CoreML (Apple Neural Engine / GPU) on macOS and the CPU elsewhere; coreml falls back to the CPU when it cannot load the model. stt-status reports the provider in use. whisper.cpp models always run on the CPU. The CoreML model (parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2-coreml) runs on the Neural Engine (MLComputeUnits cpuAndNeuralEngine) unless this is cpu (cpuOnly).

tdt_max_symbols.description: CoreML Parakeet (TDT) decoding: tokens emitted at one encoder frame before the decoder is forced to the next frame (FluidAudio maxSymbolsPerStep). Also caps the steps of the end-of-window pass.

tdt_max_tokens.description: CoreML Parakeet (TDT) decoding: most tokens decoded from one 15 s encoder window, against runaway output (FluidAudio maxTokensPerChunk).

tdt_tail_blanks.description: CoreML Parakeet (TDT) decoding: consecutive blanks that end the pass over the last frames of a window, which picks up tokens the main loop stepped past (FluidAudio consecutiveBlankLimit).

pad.description: Silence kept around the speech that is sent to the recogniser.

speaker_them.description: Speaker id written for the system-audio (them) channel.

speaker_you.description: Speaker id written for the microphone (you) channel.

speech_peak.description: Per-mille of full scale: a 10 ms frame whose peak is below this is silence (10 = 0.01).

dir.description: Folder of note-template TOML files; empty means <config dir>/templates.

activate_on_show.description: An explicit show request (tray Show Window, ctl window-show) brings the app to the front and gives it focus. The app never takes focus on its own, with this on or off.

drive_wait.description: How long a ui-select, ui-state or ui-invoke call waits for the window to answer before failing with timeout.

back.description: Back out: close the shortcuts overlay, leave Recently deleted, clear the search, then the selection. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

help.description: Show or hide the overlay listing every shortcut. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

privacy-toggle.description: Toggle hiding the window from screen capture. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

quit.description: Quit. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

record-pause.description: Pause or resume the recording. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

record-start.description: Start recording. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

record-stop.description: Stop recording (and transcribe). Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

record-toggle.description: Start recording when idle, else pause or resume it (never stops). Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

search.description: Search sessions (opens Sessions with the search box focused). Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

session-list.description: Reload the session list. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

sessions-next.description: Select the next session in the Sessions list. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

sessions-open.description: Open the selected session's notes. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

sessions-prev.description: Select the previous session in the Sessions list. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

tab-calendar.description: Go to the Calendar tab. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

tab-live.description: Go to the Live tab. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

tab-models.description: Go to the Models tab. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

tab-notes.description: Go to the Notes tab. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

tab-sessions.description: Go to the Sessions tab. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

tab-settings.description: Go to the Settings tab. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

tab-templates.description: Go to the Templates tab. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

window-hide.description: Hide the window. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

window-show.description: Show the window. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

window-toggle.description: Show or hide the window. Comma-separated keystrokes, empty for none; mod is cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

live_follow.description: The Live view scrolls to the newest line while a recording adds lines.

live_max_lines.description: Most lines the Live view keeps for one recording; older lines drop first.

quit_timeout.description: How long after ctl quit the app waits for the GUI to exit before it exits the process itself.

record_controls.description: Show the record strip (state, clock, level meters, Start, Pause / Resume and Stop) on the Live tab.

show_elapsed.description: Show the elapsed recording time (the record strip clock and the recording badge).

speaker_width.description: Width in pixels of the speaker column in transcript views.

start_hidden.description: Start with the main window closed (tray / ctl window-show opens it); off opens it at launch.

theme.description: Window colours: dark (ink blue), light (paper), or system to follow the OS appearance.

tick.description: How often the window re-reads the engine state (window visibility, capture hiding, tray).

tz.description: IANA zone the window shows meeting times in, labelled with its abbreviation; empty is the system zone (TZ, else the OS setting).
